package.author: s1dashu
package.description: 又快又安静的本地笔记应用，Rust + GPUI 原生绘制，兼容飞书文档 DocxXML 格式。

en-US.description: A fast, quiet, local-first notes app drawn natively with Rust and GPUI, compatible with Feishu (Lark) DocxXML.
en-US.longDescription:
A fast, quiet, local notes app. Drawn natively with Rust + GPUI. Your notes stay on your computer, stored in the Feishu (Lark) DocxXML format.
Fast, the native kind of fast. The whole interface is drawn on the GPU by Rust and GPUI. No WebView, no Electron. In a one-million-character document, typing, deleting and scrolling all stay under 6 ms per frame at P95.
Local-first. Your files are yours. No account, no cloud, and nothing goes over the network by default, apart from the optional update check. The library is an ordinary folder on your computer and each note is one XML file, so Git, iCloud, Nutstore or any other sync tool works, and the files remain readable if you stop using the app.
Compatible with Feishu DocxXML, with a full rich-text editor. Notes are saved in Feishu's DocxXML format, so copy-paste, import and export keep their structure. Headings, to-dos, tables, columns, callouts, code, formulas, images and attachments are all available.

zh-CN.author: s1dashu
zh-CN.description: 又快又安静的本地笔记应用，Rust + GPUI 原生绘制，兼容飞书文档 DocxXML 格式。
zh-CN.longDescription:
一个又快又安静的本地笔记应用。Rust + GPUI 原生绘制，笔记全部存在你的电脑上，兼容飞书文档的 DocxXML 格式。
快，原生的那种快。整个界面由 Rust 和 GPUI 直接用 GPU 绘制，没有 WebView、没有 Electron。百万字文档实测中，输入、删除和滚动的帧处理 P95 均低于 6 ms。
本地优先，文件归你。没有账号，没有云端，默认不联网（可选的更新检查除外）。文档库就是电脑上的一个普通文件夹，每篇笔记是一个 XML 文件。用 Git、iCloud、坚果云或任何同步工具管理都可以，哪天不用了，文件也还在。
兼容飞书 DocxXML，完整的富文本编辑器。笔记直接以飞书文档的 DocxXML 格式保存，从飞书复制粘贴、导入导出都能保留结构。标题、待办、表格、分栏、高亮块、代码、公式、图片和附件，写文档常用的块都有。
zh-CN.name: quiet.md
zh-CN.releaseNotes:
Quiet.md 0.1.10
中文
这次更新改善新建文档、表格编辑和长输入框的使用体验。
- 新建菜单可选择文档、Markdown 或文件夹，快捷新建支持记住上次类型。
- 宽表格新增可拖动的横向滚动条。
- Markdown 表格支持按列对齐，并在保存时保留对齐方式。
- 长输入框跟随光标滚动，修复链接等内容超出后看不到光标的问题。
- 调整文件夹按钮对齐，改善新建文件夹后的命名体验。
新建快捷键的默认类型可在设置中选择「记住上次 / 文档 / Markdown」。
- Linux AppImage 更新：支持应用内检查、下载和重启更新，更新包验证签名，启动失败时尝试回退。已解压运行或系统包管理器安装的版本仍由原安装方式更新。0.1.9 及更早的 Linux 版本需先手动安装本版。
English
This update improves document creation, table editing, and long input fields.
- Choose Document, Markdown, or Folder from the New menu; quick creation can remember your last choice.
- Drag the horizontal scrollbar to navigate wide tables.
- Align Markdown table columns and preserve alignment when saving.
- Long input fields scroll with the caret, including link fields.
- Align folder buttons and improve naming newly created folders.
Set the quick-create default to Remember last, Document, or Markdown in Settings.
- Linux AppImage updates: check, download, and restart to update in the app, with signature verification and rollback on an immediate launch failure. Extracted installations and distribution packages remain managed separately. Linux users on 0.1.9 or earlier need to install this version manually first.
Changes: #102, #145, #152, #153. Thanks to everyone who contributed fixes and reports.
Packages / 安装包
- macOS: Apple Silicon and Intel ZIPs, Developer ID signed and notarized.
- Windows: x64 installer; unsigned, as in 0.1.9.
- Linux: experimental x86_64 AppImage (glibc 2.35 baseline); in-app updates are supported when running the AppImage.
Linux: chmod +x quiet-md-0.1.10-x86_64.AppImage, then run it. If FUSE is unavailable, run it with --appimage-extract-and-run.
All packages include SHA-256 checksums and detached Minisign signatures, verified with packaging/update-key.pub.
Full changelog: https://github.com/s1dashu/quiet-md/compare/v0.1.9...v0.1.10
